caption: A wooden crate rests on a board that is slowly tilted up at one end; the crate stays put as the slope grows, then suddenly slides down to the bottom.

sa.check: A wooden crate rests on a board.
The board is slowly tilted up at one end.
The crate stays put as the slope grows.
It suddenly slides down to the bottom.
The tilt comes first, then the wait, then the slide.

pc.expect: It does not move at shallow angles and starts sliding all at once when the slope is steep.
pc.fail: It creeps at every angle; or slides on a level board; or slides uphill.

pc.expect: It speeds up on the way down and stops at the bottom.
pc.fail: It slows on the way down; or stops mid-slope; or floats.

pc.expect: It slides straight down the board.
pc.fail: It goes sideways; or spins; or goes off the side.

pc.expect: The crate and the board stay rigid.
pc.fail: The crate bends; or the board sags; or the crate squashes.

pc.expect: One crate and one board keep their number.
pc.fail: The crate duplicates; or vanishes; or the board turns into another object.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The crate and the board stay the same.
pc.fail: The crate changes colour; or the board changes; or the background rearranges.
